why: Multiple 2025-2026 preprints (Zenodo, Preprints.org, arXiv, ResearchGate) claim to construct a Hilbert-Pólya self-adjoint operator or prove the conjecture, but these are unreviewed/non-peer-reviewed venues with no corroboration from mainstream number theorists, so it is unclear whether any genuinely resolves the stated problem versus being speculative or flawed constructions.
queries: Hilbert-Polya conjecture self-adjoint operator zeta zeros 2025 2026
